name: Primitive Dirichlet character
ant_standard_definition: A Dirichlet character not induced from any proper divisor of its modulus.
ant_to_pvg_map: Decode valuation points to residue classes and attach the character phase together with a minimal-modulus certificate.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Recover the finite residue-phase table and its minimal modulus.
kernel_or_information_loss: Analytic continuation and the functional equation are not encoded.

name: Conductor
ant_standard_definition: The least modulus f from which a Dirichlet character is induced.
ant_to_pvg_map: Identify the minimal residue-channel period carrying the same phase observable.
pvg_geometric_object: Minimal residue partition supporting the phase table.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Return the least modulus compatible with the finite character data.
kernel_or_information_loss: No analytic L-function data are included.

name: Induced character
ant_standard_definition: A character modulo q obtained from a primitive character modulo f dividing q, extended by zero off the units modulo q.
ant_to_pvg_map: Refine a primitive residue-phase channel to a larger residue partition and preserve zeros off the unit classes.
pvg_geometric_object: Lifted residue-phase observable on a refined partition.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Collapse the refined phase table to its primitive source and conductor.
kernel_or_information_loss: Without conductor metadata, distinct presentations can represent the same primitive source.

name: Gauss sum
ant_standard_definition: tau(chi)=sum_{a mod q} chi(a) exp(2 pi i a/q).
ant_to_pvg_map: Apply the finite additive Fourier transform to the residue-phase observable.
pvg_geometric_object: Finite Fourier coefficient of a residue-phase channel.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Evaluate the same finite Gauss sum from the decoded phase table.
kernel_or_information_loss: A single Gauss sum does not recover the full character table.

name: Primitive Gauss magnitude
ant_to_pvg_map: Interpret the theorem as a norm identity for the finite Fourier transform of a primitive residue-phase observable.
pvg_geometric_object: Norm certificate on a primitive phase channel.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Return the standard Gauss-sum magnitude statement.
kernel_or_information_loss: The translation does not provide the proof or historical priority.

name: Character parity
ant_standard_definition: a in {0,1} is determined by chi(-1)=(-1)^a.
ant_to_pvg_map: Read parity as reflection behavior of the residue-phase observable under a to -a.
pvg_geometric_object: Reflection parity label on the finite phase table.
kernel_or_information_loss: Parity alone does not recover the character.

name: Completed L-function
ant_to_pvg_map: Attach conductor and parity metadata to the finite character channel while marking the Gamma factor and continuation as external analytic data.

name: Functional equation
ant_to_pvg_map: Represent the theorem as an external symmetry certificate attached to the finite character channel.

name: Root number
ant_standard_definition: epsilon(chi)=tau(chi)/(i^a sqrt(q)) for primitive chi under the standard normalization.
ant_to_pvg_map: Combine finite Gauss-sum data, conductor, and parity to compute the normalized phase factor.
pvg_geometric_object: Finite-to-analytic interface scalar of unit modulus.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Recover the standard root-number expression from the finite data.
kernel_or_information_loss: The root number does not recover the full character or its zeros.

name: Imprimitive correction factors
ant_standard_definition: L(s,chi)=L(s,chi*) product_{p|q,p not dividing f}(1-chi*(p)p^{-s}) for chi induced by primitive chi* of conductor f.
ant_to_pvg_map: Use conductor and finite prime-divisor metadata to attach missing Euler factors to the primitive source.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Reconstruct the formal Euler-factor correction from the primitive character and modulus data.
